collection.name: HS Series
collection.short: Commercial strength, cable and free-weight equipment
collection.desc: The AFZOX HS Series is a complete commercial strength range — selectorized stations, iso-lateral plate-loaded machines, cable and multi-station systems, Olympic benches and racks, and the storage that keeps a floor working. Specified, delivered and installed across India.

categories.name: Selectorized Strength
categories.short: Single-pin stack machines for high-traffic floors
categories.desc: Shrouded weight stacks, guided movement paths and pop-pin adjustment. The stations that keep a circuit moving — a member changes resistance in two seconds and the next one is already sitting down.

categories.name: Plate Loaded Machines
categories.short: Iso-lateral strength built around free-weight feel
categories.desc: Olympic plate-loaded stations with independent movement arms, foot-lever start assists and on-frame plate storage. The backbone of a serious free-weight floor.

categories.name: Cable & Functional
categories.desc: Cable-driven training with unrestricted movement planes, plus multi-stack jungle gyms that put four, five or eight training positions on a single bolt-down base.

categories.name: Benches & Racks
categories.short: Olympic benches, Smith, bodyweight stations and utility
categories.desc: Ladder-lock adjustment, integrated plate storage and structural steel built to stay square. Every angle a free-weight zone needs, in one visual family.

categories.name: Storage & Racking
categories.desc: The difference between a gym and a warehouse. Saddle-cradle dumbbell racking, vertical barbell storage and plate trees that keep the floor clear and audit-ready.

products.name: Seated Chest Press
products.short: Selectorized chest press with converging arms, dual grip positions and a head-supported seat.
description: The AFZOX HS Series Seated Chest Press is a single-station selectorized machine built for controlled horizontal pressing. Converging movement arms travel on a guided path, so the chest does the work without the stabilising demand of a free-weight press — which makes it a dependable first pressing station for new members and a high-throughput option during peak hours.

The seat carries a full backrest and head pad, and two grip positions on each arm let the lifter choose a wider or narrower press. Resistance is set on a single-pin weight stack, so changeovers between users take seconds.
features: Converging movement arms on a guided pressing path
Two grip positions per arm for wide or narrow pressing
Shrouded stack with a printed instruction placard
products.primaryApplication: Controlled horizontal pressing for upper-body strength development.

products.name: Pectoral Fly / Rear Deltoid
products.short: Dual-function pec deck — chest fly one way, rear deltoid the other, from a single seat.
description: The AFZOX HS Series Pectoral Fly / Rear Deltoid covers two opposing movements on one footprint. Facing the machine, the lifter works a chest fly through horizontal adduction; turning to face out converts the same arms into a rear deltoid station.

The movement arms pivot from an overhead cross-member and carry adjustable start positions, so the range of motion can be set to the user rather than the other way round. It is a space-efficient way to cover both the front and the rear of the shoulder girdle in a circuit.
features: Dual function — pectoral fly and rear deltoid on one frame
Adjustable start position on each arm
Shrouded stack with a printed instruction placard
products.primaryApplication: Chest fly and rear-deltoid training from a single station.

products.name: Lat Pulldown / Seated Row
products.short: Two-in-one back station — overhead pulldown above, chest-supported row below.
description: The AFZOX HS Series Lat Pulldown / Seated Row combines the two staple back movements into one dual-station frame. The upper station runs a wide angled bar for vertical pulling; the lower station pairs a chest pad and seat for horizontal rowing.

Thigh rollers hold the lifter down through the pulldown, and the chest pad on the row side takes the lower back out of the movement so the pull comes from the lats and mid-back. Both stations draw from the same shrouded weight stack.
features: Dual station — lat pulldown and seated row on one frame
Wide angled pulldown bar with rubber end grips
Chest pad and adjustable seat on the row station
products.primaryApplication: Vertical and horizontal back pulling from one dual station.

products.name: Assisted Chin / Dip
products.short: Counterweighted chin and dip station that scales bodyweight work to any starting strength.
description: The AFZOX HS Series Assisted Chin / Dip uses a counterweighted knee platform to offset a share of the lifter’s bodyweight, bringing pull-ups and dips within reach of members who cannot yet perform them unassisted — and letting stronger members run higher-rep sets.

Angled chin grips and parallel dip handles are both fixed to the same frame, with step platforms either side for mounting. Selecting more weight on the stack means more assistance, so progression is simply a matter of pinning less.
features: Counterweighted knee platform — more weight means more assistance
Step-up platforms on both sides for safe mounting
Shrouded stack with a printed instruction placard
products.primaryApplication: Scaled bodyweight pulling and pressing for mixed-ability floors.

products.name: Biceps Curl
products.short: Preacher-style selectorized curl with a fixed arm pad that removes body english.
description: The AFZOX HS Series Biceps Curl seats the lifter behind a wide angled preacher pad so the upper arms stay fixed through the curl. With the torso locked out of the movement, load goes to the elbow flexors instead of the lower back.
The seat adjusts on a pop-pin so the pad meets the arm at the right height for different users, and resistance changes on a single-pin stack.
features: Wide angled preacher pad supporting both upper arms
Shrouded stack with a printed instruction placard
products.primaryApplication: Isolated elbow flexion with the torso fully supported.

products.name: Abdominal Crunch / Back Extension
products.short: Dual-function trunk station — weighted crunch one way, back extension the other.
description: The AFZOX HS Series Abdominal Crunch / Back Extension trains both sides of the trunk from one seat. Facing in, the lifter drives a padded torso roller forward for a resisted crunch; turning around puts the same roller behind the back for a resisted extension.
A height-adjustable seat, side grip handles and a wide foot platform keep the lifter positioned through both directions, and the movement runs off a single shrouded stack.
features: Dual function — resisted trunk flexion and extension
products.primaryApplication: Resisted trunk flexion and extension from a single seat.

products.name: Seated Leg Curl
products.short: Seated hamstring curl with a locking thigh pad and an adjustable ankle roller.
description: The AFZOX HS Series Seated Leg Curl trains knee flexion from a seated position, with a padded thigh restraint that locks the femur down so the hamstrings work against the ankle roller rather than lifting the whole leg.

The ankle roller position and the backrest both adjust, letting the machine fit a wide range of leg lengths. Sitting upright is easier to set up and supervise than a prone curl, which is why it earns its place on busy floors.
features: Shrouded stack with a printed instruction placard
products.primaryApplication: Seated knee flexion for posterior-chain balance.

products.name: Hip Abductor / Adductor
products.short: Dual-function inner and outer thigh machine with a repositionable pad set.
description: The AFZOX HS Series Hip Abductor / Adductor covers both sides of the hip from one seat. With the pads set outside the knees the lifter drives out against them for abduction; repositioning the pads inside the knees converts the same machine to adduction.
A reclined backrest and a wide seat keep the pelvis stable, and the whole movement runs from a single shrouded stack with a pop-pin selector.
features: Dual function — hip abduction and adduction
Repositionable knee pads for both movements
Reclined backrest with a wide seat
Foot rests either side of the pad carriage
products.primaryApplication: Inner and outer thigh training for hip stability and balance.

products.name: Seated Leg Press
products.short: Selectorized horizontal leg press with independent foot plates and a supported seat.
description: The AFZOX HS Series Seated Leg Press runs a horizontal pressing path from a fully supported seat, which keeps spinal loading low compared with a squat or an angled sled. Two independent foot plates let each leg travel on its own line.
Resistance changes on a single-pin stack rather than by loading plates, so the station stays moving during circuits and inductions. A tall backrest and side handles hold position through the press.
features: Horizontal pressing path from a supported seat
Seat carriage adjustment along the rail
products.primaryApplication: Low-spinal-load leg pressing for circuits and general strength.

products.name: Horizontal Leg Press
products.short: Lever-action leg press with a single wide foot plate and a sliding seat carriage.
description: The AFZOX HS Series Horizontal Leg Press drives a single wide foot plate through a lever linkage while the lifter sits on a carriage that slides along the base rail. Setting the carriage position sets the starting knee angle, which makes the machine straightforward to fit to taller and shorter users alike.
The seated, back-supported position keeps the movement accessible for general members and rehabilitation-minded programming, and the shrouded single-pin stack keeps changeovers quick.
features: Single wide pivoting foot plate on a lever linkage
Sliding seat carriage sets the starting knee angle
Full-length base rail with bolt-down feet
Shrouded stack with a printed instruction placard
products.primaryApplication: Seated horizontal leg pressing with an adjustable start position.

products.name: Plate Loaded Chest Press
products.short: Iso-lateral plate-loaded chest press with independent arms and a foot-lever start assist.
description: The AFZOX HS Series Plate Loaded Chest Press gives each arm its own loading path, so a stronger side cannot carry a weaker one through the rep. The result is a free-weight feel with the stability of a guided machine.

A foot lever brings the handles into the start position, so the lifter is not fighting the load on the way in. Plate horns on the frame keep loading and stripping local to the station. Shown here in black, and also pictured in the red upholstery option.
features: Frame-mounted plate horns for on-station storage
products.primaryApplication: Iso-lateral chest pressing with a free-weight strength curve.

products.name: Plate Loaded Chest Press / Row
products.short: Dual-purpose plate-loaded station covering a seated press and a seated row.
description: The AFZOX HS Series Plate Loaded Chest Press / Row covers a pushing and a pulling movement from one frame, which is a practical answer when floor space is the constraint rather than budget.
Movement arms carry adjustable handle positions and the seat adjusts on a pop-pin. Plate horns are built into the uprights so loading stays at the station.
features: Dual function — seated press and seated row
Adjustable handle positions on both arms
products.primaryApplication: Opposing push and pull patterns from one plate-loaded frame.

products.name: Plate Loaded High Row
products.short: Chest-supported plate-loaded high row with converging overhead arms.
description: The AFZOX HS Series Plate Loaded High Row pulls from above shoulder height on a converging arc, hitting the upper lats and the mid-back at an angle a flat row cannot reach.
An upright seat with a torso restraint keeps the lifter anchored so the pull is not turned into a hip-driven heave, and independent arms mean each side is loaded on its own.
features: Upright seat with torso restraint bar
products.primaryApplication: High-angle back pulling with full torso support.

products.name: Plate Loaded Lat Pulldown
products.short: Plate-loaded lat pulldown with a long overhead arc, multi-grip handles and knee restraint.
description: The AFZOX HS Series Plate Loaded Lat Pulldown runs a long arced movement arm from well above head height, giving the lats a full stretch at the top of the rep before the pull begins.
A padded knee roller holds the lifter down against the load, and the clustered multi-grip handles allow wide, neutral and narrow pulls without changing attachments.
features: Long overhead arc for a full stretch at the top
Multi-grip handle cluster — wide, neutral and narrow
products.primaryApplication: Vertical pulling with multiple grip options from one arm.

products.name: Plate Loaded Seated Row
products.short: Chest-supported plate-loaded row with an adjustable pad and rotating handles.
description: The AFZOX HS Series Plate Loaded Seated Row uses an adjustable chest pad to take the lower back out of the movement entirely, so the pull comes from the lats and mid-back instead of hip drive — the most common fault on free-weight rows.
Rotating handles let the wrist find its own line through the pull, and the independent arms load each side separately.
features: Independent left and right movement arms
products.primaryApplication: Chest-supported horizontal rowing for the mid-back.

products.name: Plate Loaded Chest Supported Row
products.short: Standing T-bar style row with an angled chest pad and stepped foot platforms.
description: The AFZOX HS Series Plate Loaded Chest Supported Row is a standing row built around an angled chest pad. The lifter braces on stepped foot platforms with the sternum against the pad, which fixes the torso and lets heavy loading go straight into the back.
The single loading sleeve takes standard Olympic plates, and the handle assembly sits directly under the chest for a short, powerful pulling arc.
products.primaryApplication: Heavy chest-supported rowing without lower-back loading.

products.name: Plate Loaded Abdominal Crunch
products.short: Seated plate-loaded crunch with over-shoulder handles and an ankle restraint.
description: The AFZOX HS Series Plate Loaded Abdominal Crunch lets the trunk be loaded properly rather than trained only against bodyweight. The lifter sits with the back supported, grips the over-shoulder handles and drives into flexion against the plates.
An ankle roller anchors the lower body so the movement stays in the trunk, and the seat adjusts on a pop-pin to set the pivot at the right height.
features: Padded backrest with a chest pad
products.primaryApplication: Progressively loaded trunk flexion.

products.name: Plate Loaded Prone Leg Curl
products.short: Plate-loaded prone hamstring curl with a torso pad and an adjustable seat.
description: The AFZOX HS Series Plate Loaded Prone Leg Curl positions the lifter against a large torso pad so the hips stay down through the curl — the position that keeps the hamstrings loaded from full extension rather than letting the pelvis roll.
Loading is by Olympic plate, so the station suits dedicated strength floors where hamstring work is progressed alongside heavy lower-body lifts.
products.primaryApplication: Prone knee flexion for posterior-chain strength.

products.name: Plate Loaded Seated Leg Press
products.short: Plate-loaded seated leg press with a lever foot platform and a head-supported backrest.
description: The AFZOX HS Series Plate Loaded Seated Leg Press drives a wide foot platform through a lever linkage from a reclined, head-supported seat. Because the load sits on plate horns rather than a stack, the ceiling is set by the floor’s plate inventory rather than by the machine.
The seated position keeps spinal compression low relative to a squat, which makes it a workhorse for high-volume leg work.
products.primaryApplication: Heavy seated leg pressing with plate-loaded resistance.

products.name: 45 Degree Leg Press
products.short: Classic 45° sled leg press on linear guide rails with a large textured foot plate.
description: The AFZOX HS Series 45 Degree Leg Press is the standard heavy leg station: a carriage running on linear guide rails at 45°, a large textured foot plate, and a reclined back pad that lets the lifter brace hard against the load.
Safety catches along the rails and side-mounted release handles let a lifter rack the sled from the bottom position under their own control. Plate horns on the uprights keep loading at the machine.
features: Carriage on linear guide rails at 45°
Multiple safety catch positions along the rails
products.primaryApplication: Heavy angled leg pressing for strength floors.

products.name: Plate Loaded Glute Drive
products.short: Plate-loaded hip-extension station with an adjustable back pad and foot platform.
description: The AFZOX HS Series Plate Loaded Glute Drive turns the barbell hip thrust into a set-up-and-go station. The lifter braces against an adjustable back pad with the feet on a fixed platform and drives the padded lever into hip extension.

Because the load is carried on a lever rather than across the lap as a bare bar, sets are quicker to set up and far more comfortable — which is the main reason the movement gets programmed consistently rather than avoided.
features: Padded hip lever driven by Olympic plates
Full-length base rail with bolt-down feet
products.primaryApplication: Loaded hip extension for posterior-chain and glute development.

products.name: Plate Loaded Standing Calf Raise
products.short: Standing calf raise with padded shoulder yokes and a raised stepped foot platform.
description: The AFZOX HS Series Plate Loaded Standing Calf Raise loads the calves through padded shoulder yokes while the lifter stands on a raised platform, so the heels can drop below the toes for a full stretch at the bottom of every rep.
The yoke height adjusts to the user and the load is carried on Olympic plates, which lets calf work be progressed properly rather than being limited by a light stack.
features: Padded shoulder yokes with height adjustment
Raised stepped foot platform for a full stretch
Grip handle on the yoke assembly
products.primaryApplication: Standing calf work through a full range of ankle motion.

products.name: Ab Crunch Bench
products.short: Low-profile loaded crunch station with a padded arm rest, handles and foot restraints.
description: The AFZOX HS Series Ab Crunch Bench keeps the loaded crunch low to the floor on an open arched frame, which makes it easy to get into and easy to supervise.
The lifter sits on the pad, takes the handles and drives the padded arm rest forward against the load while the feet stay hooked under the restraints. Resistance is added on the loading sleeve.
features: Padded arm and chest rest with vertical handles
products.primaryApplication: Loaded trunk flexion from a low, accessible position.

products.name: Cable Crossover
products.short: Twin-tower cable crossover with height-adjustable pulleys and an overhead chin bar.
description: The AFZOX HS Series Cable Crossover puts two independently adjustable pulley carriages either side of an open training bay. Because each carriage moves the full height of the upright, the same frame covers high flyes, low raises, mid-height presses and pulls, and everything in between.
The arched top bridge carries a multi-grip chin bar, so the station also serves as a pull-up point without adding floor area.
features: Full-height adjustment range on both uprights
Arched bridge with a multi-grip chin bar
Open training bay between the towers
products.primaryApplication: Multi-plane cable training for chest, shoulders and arms.

products.name: Dual Adjustable Pulley
products.short: Compact functional trainer with two adjustable pulleys, a chin bar and a guided bar.
description: The AFZOX HS Series Dual Adjustable Pulley is the most versatile single frame on a small floor. Two independent pulley carriages adjust through the full height of the uprights, letting one station cover pressing, pulling, rotation, chops and single-arm work across every plane.
A multi-grip chin bar spans the top and a guided bar runs on the rear uprights, so bodyweight and barbell-pattern work happen at the same station.
features: Guided bar on the rear uprights
Numbered carriage positions for repeatable set-up
products.primaryApplication: Functional and rehabilitation-friendly cable training across all planes.

products.name: 4 Station Multi Jungle Gym
products.short: Four-stack multi station covering pulldown, row, leg and cable work around one tower.
description: The AFZOX HS Series 4 Station Multi Jungle Gym clusters four independent weight stacks around a single tower, so four members can train at once without four separate footprints.
The stations cover a high pulldown with attachments, a seated leg station, a low pulley and an adjustable cable position — the core of a small-floor strength offering in one bolt-down unit.
features: High pulldown station with bar and rope attachments
Seated leg station with roller pads
Adjustable cable position with single handles
One bolt-down base serving four training positions
products.primaryApplication: Four simultaneous training positions on one compact footprint.

products.name: 5 Station Multi Jungle Gym
products.short: Four-stack tower with a satellite lat tower and a long multi-grip bar spanning both.
description: The AFZOX HS Series 5 Station Multi Jungle Gym extends the four-stack tower with a separate satellite station carrying its own weight stack, linked by a long multi-grip bar that spans the two frames.
The layout suits floors that want a fifth training position and an overhead grip station without committing to a second full tower.
features: Satellite tower with its own stack and pulley
Long multi-grip bar spanning both frames
Seated row bench and leg station on the main tower
Dual high pulleys with handle attachments
Bolt-down levelling feet on both frames
products.primaryApplication: Five training positions with an extended overhead grip station.

products.name: 8 Station Multi Jungle Gym
products.short: Twin four-stack towers joined by an arched bridge — eight stacks, one installation.
description: The AFZOX HS Series 8 Station Multi Jungle Gym joins two four-stack towers with an arched top bridge, giving eight independent training positions and a crossover bay in a single installation.

It is the configuration to specify when a floor needs to move a lot of members through resistance training quickly — circuits, inductions and personal training can all run on the same frame at the same time.
features: Twin four-stack towers on one linked frame
Arched bridge with a multi-grip chin bar
Open crossover bay between the towers
High, mid and low pulley positions per tower
Seated leg and row positions on both towers
products.primaryApplication: High-throughput circuit and small-group training.

products.name: Smith Machine
products.short: Counterbalanced Smith machine on angled steel runners with multi-position catches.
description: The AFZOX HS Series Smith Machine runs an Olympic bar on angled steel runners, so the bar path is fixed and a lifter can push close to failure without a spotter. Rotating the bar into the hook positions racks it anywhere along the travel.
The arched frame keeps the training bay open, and plate horns on both uprights hold working plates at the station.
features: Guided bar on angled steel runners
Multi-position hook catches along the full travel
products.primaryApplication: Guided barbell squatting, pressing and pulling without a spotter.

products.name: Olympic Flat Bench Press
products.short: Commercial flat bench press with ladder uprights and integrated plate storage.
description: The AFZOX HS Series Olympic Flat Bench Press pairs a three-section flat pad with A-frame uprights carrying a ladder of bar hooks, so the rack height can be matched to the lifter rather than the other way round.
Six plate horns are built into the uprights, which keeps the working set at the bench and the walkways clear.
features: Ladder bar hooks for rack height adjustment
products.primaryApplication: Flat barbell pressing in a commercial free-weight zone.

products.name: Olympic Incline Bench Press
products.short: Fixed-incline Olympic bench press with a spotter platform and plate storage.
description: The AFZOX HS Series Olympic Incline Bench Press sets the pad at a fixed incline for upper-chest pressing, with a raised spotter platform behind the head of the bench so a training partner can work from a proper stance.
Ladder hooks on both uprights set the rack height, and integrated plate horns keep loading local.
features: Fixed incline bench pad with seat
Ladder bar hooks on both uprights
products.primaryApplication: Incline barbell pressing for upper-chest development.

products.name: Olympic Decline Bench Press
products.short: Decline Olympic bench press with leg restraint rollers and integrated plate storage.
description: The AFZOX HS Series Olympic Decline Bench Press sets the pad on a decline with padded leg rollers to lock the lifter in position, targeting the lower chest through a shortened, mechanically strong pressing range.
Ladder hooks set the rack height and plate horns on the uprights keep the working plates at the bench.
features: Decline bench pad with a lift-out assist handle
Ladder bar hooks on both uprights
A-frame uprights on a wide base
products.primaryApplication: Decline barbell pressing for lower-chest work.

products.name: Olympic Adjustable Bench Press
products.short: Olympic press station with a multi-angle bench that wheels out of the rack.
description: The AFZOX HS Series Olympic Adjustable Bench Press combines a fixed upright rack with a multi-angle bench that rolls clear on transport wheels, so one station covers flat, incline and decline pressing — and the bench can be pulled out for dumbbell work.
Ladder hooks set the rack height for whichever angle is in use, and plate horns are built into the frame.
features: Multi-angle bench with ladder-lock back adjustment
Transport wheels and pull handle on the bench
Ladder bar hooks on both uprights
Bench rolls clear of the rack for dumbbell work
products.primaryApplication: Flat, incline and decline pressing from one rack.

products.name: Adjustable FID Bench
products.short: Flat–incline–decline bench with ladder-lock adjustment, head pad and transport wheels.
description: The AFZOX HS Series Adjustable FID Bench covers flat, incline and decline from one frame using a ladder-lock back adjustment that holds position under load without tools.

A separate head pad supports the neck on steep inclines, and transport wheels with a pull handle let staff reposition the bench between dumbbell racks and power racks without lifting it. Pictured with and without the leg hold-down rollers.
features: Ladder-lock back adjustment through flat, incline and decline
Narrow back pad profile for shoulder clearance
products.primaryApplication: Multi-angle bench support for free-weight training.

products.name: Multi-Adjustable Bench
products.short: Multi-angle bench on an arched base with pop-pin back adjustment and a head pad.
description: The AFZOX HS Series Multi-Adjustable Bench sits on a curved tubular base that keeps the footprint tight while staying stable under heavy dumbbell work.
The back adjusts on a pop-pin through the pressing angles, and the separate head pad supports the neck at steeper settings.
products.primaryApplication: Seated and inclined dumbbell work in free-weight zones.

products.name: Flat Bench
products.short: Fixed flat bench with a three-section pad, arched base and transport handle.
description: The AFZOX HS Series Flat Bench is the plain, dependable pad every free-weight floor needs several of. A three-section top gives shoulder clearance at the ends while keeping the centre solid.
The arched tubular base clears the floor for foot placement, and a transport handle at one end lets a single member of staff move it.
features: Arched tubular base with floor clearance
products.primaryApplication: Flat support for pressing, rows and dumbbell work.

products.name: Utility Bench
products.short: Fixed upright utility bench with a vertical back pad and a rear foot rest.
description: The AFZOX HS Series Utility Bench holds a fixed upright back angle for seated shoulder pressing, seated curls and any movement that wants a vertical torso without an adjustment to set.
Because nothing moves, the bench never drifts out of position and there is no mechanism to service — the reason fixed uprights still earn a place next to adjustable benches.
products.primaryApplication: Seated overhead pressing and supported arm work.

products.name: Workout Stool
products.short: Padded workout stool with a wide contoured seat and a low tubular base.
description: The AFZOX HS Series Workout Stool is a simple padded seat for cable stations, dumbbell curls and assessments — the piece that disappears until it is missing.
A wide contoured top and a low tubular base keep it stable in use and easy to slide out of the way afterwards.
products.primaryApplication: Seated support at cable stations and dumbbell racks.

products.name: Adjustable Decline Ab Bench
products.short: Multi-position decline ab bench with padded ankle rollers and an assist handle.
description: The AFZOX HS Series Adjustable Decline Ab Bench sets the decline angle on a pop-pin, so trunk work can be made progressively harder without adding external load.
Padded ankle rollers hold the legs, an assist handle helps members get in and out of position, and the arched base keeps the frame stable at the steepest setting.
products.primaryApplication: Progressive bodyweight trunk flexion.

products.name: 45 Degree Back Extension
products.short: 45° back extension with adjustable hip pads, ankle rollers and plate horns.
description: The AFZOX HS Series 45 Degree Back Extension trains the posterior chain through hip and trunk extension at an angle that is easier to enter than a horizontal hyperextension.
The hip pad height and the ankle roller position both adjust, and two plate horns on the base let a member keep a plate ready for weighted sets.
features: Two plate storage horns on the base
products.primaryApplication: Posterior-chain extension work and lower-back conditioning.

products.name: Preacher Curl Bench
products.short: Free-weight preacher curl bench with a wide angled arm pad and an adjustable seat.
description: The AFZOX HS Series Preacher Curl Bench fixes the upper arms against a wide angled pad so a barbell or dumbbell curl is performed without swinging the torso.
The seat adjusts on a pop-pin to set the pad at the right height, and bar rests either side of the pad let a lifter park the bar between sets.
features: Bar rests either side of the pad
products.primaryApplication: Strict free-weight curling with the upper arms fixed.

products.name: Vertical Knee Raise / Chin / Dip Station
products.short: Power tower combining knee raise, dip, chin-up and back support in one frame.
description: The AFZOX HS Series Vertical Knee Raise / Chin / Dip Station stacks the core bodyweight movements into a single frame: hanging knee raises from the forearm pads, dips from the parallel handles, and chin-ups from the angled overhead bar.
Step platforms either side make mounting straightforward, and the back pad supports the spine through the knee-raise position.
features: Angled overhead chin-up bar with rubber grips
Padded forearm rests for hanging knee raises
products.primaryApplication: Bodyweight strength and trunk work on one footprint.

specs.Primary Movement: Bodyweight pulling, pressing and trunk flexion

tags: Bodyweight pulling, pressing and trunk flexion

products.name: Vertical Knee Raise / Dip Station
products.short: Compact knee-raise and dip station with forearm pads, back support and step platforms.
description: The AFZOX HS Series Vertical Knee Raise / Dip Station covers hanging knee raises and parallel-bar dips in a frame that fits where a full power tower will not.
Padded forearm rests and a full back pad hold the trunk in position for the knee raise, and step platforms either side make mounting easy.
features: Padded forearm rests for hanging knee raises
Compact open frame — no overhead bar
products.primaryApplication: Bodyweight trunk and pressing work in a compact footprint.

products.name: Barbell Rack
products.short: Vertical barbell rack holding fixed or Olympic bars upright in moulded saddles.
description: The AFZOX HS Series Barbell Rack stands bars on end in moulded saddles, so a full set of fixed barbells occupies a fraction of the floor a horizontal rack would need.
The arched twin-column frame is bolt-down and the saddles are set at a consistent pitch, which makes the rack easy to audit at a glance and quick to reset after a class.
features: Vertical saddle storage for multiple bars
Consistent saddle pitch for quick visual audit
products.primaryApplication: Vertical storage for fixed and Olympic barbells.

products.name: Olympic Plate Tree
products.short: A-frame Olympic plate tree with six horns for sorted plate storage.
description: The AFZOX HS Series Olympic Plate Tree keeps loose plates off the floor and sorted by denomination across six horns on an A-frame.

Storing plates at working height is the difference between a floor that resets itself after every session and one that has to be tidied — and it removes the most common trip hazard in a free-weight zone.
features: Plates sorted by denomination at working height
products.primaryApplication: Sorted Olympic plate storage in free-weight zones.

products.name: Two Tier Dumbbell Rack
products.short: Two-tier dumbbell rack with moulded saddle cradles on a curved frame.
description: The AFZOX HS Series Two Tier Dumbbell Rack holds a full dumbbell set in moulded saddle cradles across two curved tiers, angled so the handles present toward the user.
The two-tier height suits floors where members need to reach the top row comfortably, and the open frame keeps the set visible and easy to audit.
features: Two tiers of moulded saddle cradles
Curved tiers angling handles toward the user
Low reach height on the top row
products.primaryApplication: Dumbbell storage for studios and compact free-weight zones.

products.name: Three Tier Dumbbell Rack
products.short: Three-tier dumbbell rack storing a larger set in a comparable footprint.
description: The AFZOX HS Series Three Tier Dumbbell Rack adds a third row of moulded saddle cradles, taking a larger dumbbell set in close to the same floor area as a two-tier rack.
The tiers are curved so handles present toward the user on every row, and the whole set stays visible for a quick end-of-day check.
features: Three tiers of moulded saddle cradles
Curved tiers angling handles toward the user
Higher capacity in a comparable footprint
products.primaryApplication: High-capacity dumbbell storage for commercial floors.
